done_when: Merge reads the newest finished full run on the default branch, scheduled or started by hand, so a green full run started by hand after the repair frees story merges, and the hold message says that a full run started by hand clears it; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade
why: After a failed nightly full run, story merges stay held until the next scheduled run even when a repair merged and a full run started by hand on main passed, because merge reads only scheduled runs
